title: The Extraction of Geneva
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Lena Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
